purpose: Fresh hand-inked field-guide art direction; not based on prior project spikes
prompt: Create an original grayscale pixel-art concept sheet for a 128×64 monochrome handheld overworld. Do not imitate any existing game or use reference art. Wide 2:1 canvas, exact 2-column by 2-row equal landscape panels, 2:1 panel proportions, separated by a narrow plain white gutter. No text, labels, UI or panel borders. Strict top-down orthographic JRPG map, no isometric angle or horizon. Direction: hand-inked storybook pixel art, like a tiny black-ink field guide with bold outer contours, woodcut-like large shadow shapes and carefully grouped interior marks. Keep strokes chunky enough for 128×64, with open white walking routes and clear 16×16 scale landmarks. Leave the screen center open for an added 16×16 player. Grayscale only with broad values from white to black; no baked dithering, noise, grain, crosshatching or halftone. Upper-left cave: irregular inked rock edges, a dark pool, a few crystal clusters and a readable winding path. Upper-right forest: overlapping tree canopies around a bright winding trail, a fallen log and ferns. Lower-left rural town: a pair of small cottages, picket fence, garden plots and a well along a village lane. Lower-right city: compact storefront fronts around a central plaza, paved squares and simple street lamps. Make the contour and shadow language distinct from soft shaded illustration, while keeping shapes crisp and legible.
